The '''Lerct Historical Institute''', also referred to simply as '''Lerct''', was an educational institution based out of the celestial body [[Lerct/Legends|Lerct]]<ref name="AIR" /> in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Prackla sector/Legends|Prackla sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Lerct system/Legends|Lerct system]]</ref> At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Ther-das]] was enrolled in the institute. During his second year as a student there, however, he became addicted to [[Salt/Legends|salt]] and his academic career was nearly undone. When Ther-das' addiction was discovered, he was expelled from the institute and placed in a recovery program.<ref name="AIR" />

Afterward Ther-das was eventually re-admitted to the Lerct Historical Institute. He went on to graduate one season ahead of his projected schedule and received a degree in ancient [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]]. Soon after graduating from the institute, the Arcona received the position of acquisitions director of the [[Ancient Weaponry]] department of the [[Zuliria Museum of Antiquities]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] celestial body [[Zuliria]].<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lerct Historical Institute was mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" />
